entries.name: Forward-P/E valuation substitution for the non-crypto MVRV-Z analogue
entries.why: Live data shows forward P/E 19.6 (approx. its own 5y/10y averages) and CAPE 41.9 (approx. 29% above long-run average, near a 150y record) are both simultaneously true, and the MVRV-Z analogue chosen for this framework is CAPE, not forward P/E. Forward P/E would have scored the 2026-08-04 SPX leg at the Oct-2007-top level and capped the equity ceiling at 12 against unlock lines of 11/13. The motivating premise (that the leg over-credits by ~4 points) is not supported by the live cross-check; the leg is recorded as correctly scored.

entries.name: Non-crypto gate schema frozen per class (N/A {4,6,9} -> denominator 6, linter-enforced)
entries.note: ledger records 5 of the 6 adopted items as adopted-with-modification without naming which one shipped unmodified; per-tune split not preserved here.
entries.why: Repairs the 2026-07-04 mandate that specified a fixed schema with no mechanism to enforce it; four non-crypto reports had produced four different denominators.

entries.name: ATH-distance valuation fallback capped at 3 unless a pinned long-run measure is >= 90th percentile of >= 50 years
entries.why: Equity -> Shiller CAPE, metals -> CPI-deflated real price. Prevents the fallback from over-crediting a leg that a purpose-built long-run measure would score lower.

entries.name: Rounding pinned for non-crypto assets (spx/ndx half-down, no longer report-overridable)
entries.why: Removes a per-report discretion point in a rounding rule that should be mechanical.

entries.name: Untransferable crypto-native thresholds resolve to NOT MET on non-crypto calendar days
entries.why: A crypto-only gate condition that cannot be evaluated on a non-crypto asset must not default to passing.

entries.name: Channel B declared unavailable and Phase 3 unreachable on non-crypto (ceiling 18 < unlock 19)
entries.why: Non-crypto's non-crypto gate schema mechanically caps the composite below the Phase 3 unlock line; declaring the ceiling explicitly prevents a future report from treating the gap as an oversight to route around.

entries.name: Squeeze-trap penalty prints as MISSING PROTECTION rather than penalty:0 when the input is unavailable
entries.why: penalty:0 is indistinguishable from 'checked, found no squeeze risk'; the non-crypto path structurally cannot check it at all, and the two must not read the same.

entries.name: Entry-zone ratchet (SS6, entry-side, restrictive)
entries.why: An unlock authorizes a tranche inside its named zone only; a re-anchor is not itself an unlock; downward re-anchoring runs the coherence check + D6 exception 1; upward re-anchoring needs >=5 consecutive closes above the shelf + zone top below spot + a void condition, and may never raise the number the coherence check runs against. The Deep-Value Override is exempt (its trigger anchors to the last fill's blended cost, not the next zone) — the skeptic panel caught that the as-originally-proposed clause would have blocked the real $59,110 / -9.1%-off-basis Override firing, re-creating the unreachability the Jun-2026 re-anchor removed. Codifies thrice-exercised practice (ETH Jul-2->Jul-10, BTC Jul-2, gold Aug-5) that lived nowhere in the SKILL.

entries.name: Weekly-vs-daily RSI divergence leg or gate (spread and absolute constructions)
entries.why: Spread construction is anti-correlated with weekly RSI by construction, so it bites hardest at maximum washout and would knock the score below the Deep-Value Override's mechanical >=15 arming bar at the lows — this framework's own documented past failure mode. Absolute construction fires 2 of 19 reports, both already gate-blocked; out-of-sample over 2 years x 4 assets the gradient is non-monotone with three sign changes, per-asset signs disagree (ETH +7.40%, SOL -1.89%), and gold has exactly one qualifying day in two years (2026-08-05 itself).

entries.name: Breakout/volume leg or gate
entries.why: An anti-gate variant has no mechanism; a leg-level variant double-keys volume with capitulation-(a)/gate 7.

entries.name: Negative drawdown tier
entries.why: Roughly 9 percentage points from ever firing in the corpus.

entries.name: Macro leg (composite max 20 -> 22)
entries.why: Silently loosens roughly 17 absolute thresholds that are defined against the current 20-point ceiling.

entries.name: Signed gate 9
entries.why: Adding gate credit loosens unlocks on the long side; gate 9's predicate is asset-relative and already resolved differently for gold vs BTC without needing a sign.

entries.name: Score-line vacuity & binding-constraint audit (SS4, disclosure-only, one-directional)
entries.why: Score-axis mirror of the gate-reachability disclosure: attainable ceiling re-derived per report, every governing score line tagged LIVE/VACUOUS-FALSE/VACUOUS-PERMISSIVE/VACUOUS-BLOCKING against the score it actually reads (adjusted vs mechanical), binding axis named. One-directional. Deep-Value Override explicitly exempt so a vacuity tag can never bar its >=15 arming line from firing.

entries.name: EV sign attribution: symmetrized momentum-contradiction disclosure + geometry-vs-weight decomposition
entries.why: The trailing-2-week contradiction disclosure named only the bullish failure mode; the bearish one is what actually ran (BTC 15 consecutive negative machine-block EV-vs-spot prints into a +4.3% window). Negative EV must now decompose per scenario and state whether probability weight or band distance carries the sign; geometry-driven reads inform sizing DOWNWARD only. Non-dissolution clause blocks the label from dissolving the EV-floor check, the collar, or terminal-vs-extreme reconciliation.

entries.name: EV Calibration Line: per-asset forecast scorecard with same-sign-streak tripwire and EV demotion
entries.why: The framework grades its analyst (D7) and had never graded itself. >=5-distinct-report-date same-sign streak contradicted by realized price forces an on-record systematic-bias statement. Default consequence is demotion of EV to corroborative-only (cannot lift the Verdict-Confidence Collar); band re-derivation requires a cited realized trend-structure event and does NOT reset the streak. Those two constraints are bundled — unbundling re-opens a bounce-chasing hazard.

entries.name: Discharge clock on the standalone-FR obligation (SS4)
entries.why: Flying Rocket produced zero live reports across the whole window, so Hard Rule 5's inverse-consistency cross-check had no live companion for two full calibration cycles. An owed companion report may no longer roll forward on prose.

entries.name: Expire the frozen FR-coverage claim in the 2026-07-04 revision log
entries.why: A coverage claim frozen at 2026-07-04 was still readable as current after two cycles of FR silence. It now expires, and a stale coverage claim may not be quoted as current.

entries.name: Fill corroboration: LEDGER-CONFIRMED vs UNVERIFIED tranche state
entries.why: WITHHELD at pre-apply, not rejected on merit. Targets the run's largest defect (BTC narrated a filled 10% Phase 1A @ ~$65K across 9 reports, ETH HOLD ~5% @ ~$1,844 across 7, ledger shows dust and no FK tag). Incompatible with the sibling Fill-corroboration clock: this one KEEPS an unverified tranche deployed:true with its stop and LIFO ordering, the sibling RETIRES it to UNFILLED with deployed_pct 0 and forbids it anchoring a stop. Neither ships alone. Heavy toolchain coupling (lib.mjs + lint-report.mjs + selftest.mjs + export-signals.mjs with a feed schema bump) could not land this commit. NEXT RUN MUST ADJUDICATE THE TWO DESIGNS AGAINST EACH OTHER BEFORE PANELLING EITHER.

entries.name: Fill-corroboration clock (SS6, Hard Rule 8) — a narrated fill decays to Hard Rule 4's default
entries.why: WITHHELD at pre-apply as the incompatible sibling of the LEDGER-CONFIRMED/UNVERIFIED tune — same object, opposite terminal state (retire to UNFILLED vs indefinite UNVERIFIED banner). Requires lint-report.mjs in the same commit. Same instruction to the next run: adjudicate the two designs against each other first.

entries.name: Gold COT washout bar: fixed contract count -> regime-relative distributional bar
entries.why: A distributional bar recomputed on a regime that has itself shifted is self-referential — it loosens exactly when positioning normalizes at a new extreme. The fixed contract count is what keeps the gold Phase-2 unlock honest; gold's deep tranches are already score-bound rather than gate-bound.

entries.name: Compound-stop score-axis degeneracy disclosure
entries.why: Rejected on a false premise by its solo panel. The tune claimed the SKILL is silent on the continuously-satisfied score axis, but SKILL.md legislates exactly that case and the tune quoted it with the polarity INVERTED: the score key is a BRAKE on a conjunctive stop, so a continuously-satisfied key makes the stop fire MORE readily, not less. A load-bearing cited figure ('23-41% away') was also unreproducible against printed reports. A narrowed, re-polarised residue survives inside the adopted vacuity-audit tune.

entries.name: Key-Trigger decay: retire a causal channel falsified by its own consequent
entries.why: Would have auto-retired gold's real-yield channel precisely when it was about to matter, and offered no mechanism distinguishing a falsified channel from a merely slow one. The underlying observation (gold's stated causal model — real yields must roll over — was wrong on every test while the rally happened anyway) is real and is recorded in the memo instead.

entries.name: Reconcile the 2026-07-04 adopted-tune count to the nameable mechanisms
entries.why: The discrepancy is real — the 2026-07-04 revision log enumerates 36 nameable mechanisms against a '38 adopted-with-modification' headline — but silently renumbering a historical log entry is worse than the inconsistency. Recorded in the 2026-08-06 memo and revision log instead of edited into the past.

note: Append-only structured record of every adopted/rejected/withheld/unadjudicated tune from every framework-calibration run. Replaces the per-run agent that re-derived the prior-rejection list from prose memos each calibration — code now matches a proposed tune's name/surface against `verdict:"rejected"` entries here instead of trusting prompt text to hold the line. The prose ledger (calibration_ledger.md) stays the human-readable narrative history; this file is its structured, enforcement-grade twin. Entries with `source:"ledger-prose"` are backfilled from a ledger line that only carried an aggregate count (e.g. "17 rejected") with no per-tune breakdown in the ledger itself — the memo is pointed to rather than inventing tune identities. Maintained by tools/calib-registry.mjs.
